message.content:
Sunroofs for motor vehicles: CBP rulings classify framed sunroof glass assemblies under 8708.99 (other parts and accessories of motor vehicles) rather than 7007 (safety glass) because the frame and mechanism make them more than glass. Some rulings place sunroofs in 8708.99.8180 (other parts, other). Earlier rulings for sunroofs: "8708.99.8180" was used for sunroof assemblies, though the sub-numbering changed over time. Current HTSUS 8708.99: 8708.99.68 (other: parts of power train...?), 8708.99.81 (Other: Other), 8708.99.8180 is "Other." Tariff 8708.99.81 is "Other" with statistical suffix 80 "Other."

{"hts_code": "8708.99.8180", "reason": "Framed sunroof glass assemblies (including the complete sunroof with motor and rail) are identifiable parts of motor vehicles of headings 8701-8705, classified in the residual 'other parts and accessories' provision of 8708.99 rather than as glass in heading 7007."}
